text: anya: Heads-up: QA reported Create Pipeline form shifts the primary CTA when inline errors appear on mobile. users lose the submit button under the keyboard sometimes. sam: Oof. Is the error block added below the field, pushing everything down? can we overlay or reserve space? liam: Prefer reserve space. overlay can obscure content on small screens and complicate hit targets. reserve slot with max-height transition to avoid layout thrash. maria: Agree on reserve slot + subtle expand animation. accessibility note: animation should be reduced if user prefers-reduced-motion. anya: Also: do we mark required fields with a visual asterisk + hidden "Required" for screen readers, or append '(Required)' text? Translation team flagged that suffixes increase wrapping. joel: We had success with an inline sr-only token that reads before the label: `RequiredField Label`. keeps layout tight and reads correctly. sam: That works. designers worry about discoverability though. Maybe show faint 'Required' helper on focus for optional fields? liam: I'd rather have a consistent visible indicator for critical fields and use helper copy sparingly. inconsistency causes more support tickets. maria: On error announcement: field-level messages should be aria-live=polite; but our form summary uses assertive. If we reserve space, make sure the field error still fires a polite live region update so screen readers catch the change. anya: What about error animation vs sudden show? micro animation reduces jump perception but could confuse screen reader timing. any preferences? joel: Micro fade + slide in (reduced-motion respects) is fine. just ensure the live region content updates immediately (not delayed by animation). sam: New topic: destructive actions in Pipelines list. Current modal is 'Are you sure?'. security wants typed confirm for deleting active deployments. Where to set threshold? liam: Rule of thumb: typed-confirm for multi-item deletes or deleting associated infra (e.g., deployments with >0 replicas), or when deletion affects billing. Single small item: confirm modal + undo toast. maria: Copy suggestion: "Delete deployment \"staging-5\" and its running replicas. This is irreversible. Type DELETE to confirm." keep it short. anya: Paste restriction? some PMs like disabling paste so users type intentionally. Accessibility folks said don't block paste. joel: Don't block. We can mitigate accidental paste by requiring uppercase 'DELETE' or require typing the resource name which is less pasteable since names often have dashes. sam: Also consider subtle rate limit: if someone pastes we still show a 2s delay and a small animation to emphasize finality. Not a blocker, just UX flourish. liam: RTL/translation note: typed-confirm that includes resource names needs locale-aware comparison and normalization. avoid naive lower/upper checks. maria: Good call. i18n + normalization in backend validation. front-end should show live validation but server enforces final match. anya: Decision summary requested: reserve error space + micro animation (reduced-motion aware) + sr-only 'Required' token + field-level polite live + form-level assertive summary + typed-confirm for dangerous thresholds (no paste block, normalize server-side). agreed? sam: +1 liam: +1 joel: +1 anya: I'll make a tiny prototype and PR for the form component and the modal patterns, and include copy variants for legal review. will tag eng and intl. design-bot: Created issue #2942 — forms: mobile error-slot + typed-confirm pattern (assigned: anya).
